proposals.rationale: Source describes a former shop that seems to have closed. Retain the tentative observation and three-row rhythm; omit only the redundant Korean auxiliary 버린. Original draft remains unchanged.
Retain the stereo program's segmented singing, self-introduction, stretched vowel and shout. Contract 나는 to 난 and keep audible stretching; original longer performance remains a review alternative.
Retain the stammer, threatening debt/retaliation metaphor, pause and source certainty 必ず. Korean demonstrative is implicit; no source event/outcome is altered.
Retain the target-directed contempt, unworthiness of a finishing blow and dismissal. Redistribute the Korean clause within the same two source lines without changing line/page/wait tokens.
Use the equivalent Korean adverb 정정당당히 rather than 정정당당하게. Retain the challenge, pause, emphasis and two-row source structure.
